name: parallel-fanout
summary: For work that splits into independent parts. A lead fixes the interfaces, workers build parts at the same time, an integrator joins them.

roles.name: lead
roles.job: Splits the work into independent parts. Writes the shared interface and who owns which files.

roles.name: worker
roles.job: Builds one part and its tests. Changes only the files it owns. Use one worker for each part.

roles.name: integrator
roles.job: Joins the parts, connects shared code (registry, CLI) and runs all tests.

roles.name: tester
roles.job: Tests the full system against the spec, not against the code.

steps.do: Write the plan: the parts, the owner of each file, and the shared interface.
Each worker builds its part with tests, at the same time as the other workers.
Join the parts. Fix conflicts. Run all tests.
Check each rule in the spec end to end. Send problems to the owner.

rules: Workers must not change files that other workers own.
Workers must work at the same time, not one after the other.
